## Social caption — weekend look-ahead

Suggested use: Friday 18 September after recheck. Retire before Saturday 19 September 11:00 UK; never move this Saturday workshop into Sunday's copy.

Bristol, fancy making a planet without paying for a ticket? 🧡

**Saturday 19 September, 11am–1pm:** Paper Play with Colourful Minds at the **Tobacco Factory Stretch Tent**. Free, drop-in planet making as part of the South Bristol Arts Trail. Our suggested fit: ages 3–12 with grown-up help; the organiser doesn’t give a numerical age limit.

The wider trail runs **19–20 September, 11am–5pm**, across Southville, Bedminster and Ashton. Pick a short route from the map — you don’t have to see everything.

## Friday weekend-brief email

Intended issue: Friday 18 September, 15:30 UK, after fresh checks. Retire before Saturday 19 September 11:00 UK.

Subject: Bristol: free art, little makers and a short BS3 wander

Preheader: The Arts Trail is back on 19–20 September.

Hi Bristol,

Our weekend pick is the **[South Bristol Arts Trail](https://southbristolarts.co.uk/)**: free to explore on **19–20 September, 11am–5pm**.

For a hands-on start, try **[Paper Play at the Tobacco Factory Stretch Tent](https://southbristolarts.co.uk/workshops-performances/)** on **Saturday, 11am–1pm**. Free drop-in; our suggested fit is ages 3–12 with adult help, not an organiser age restriction. Places and materials aren’t guaranteed.

Then choose a couple of nearby stops in Southville, Bedminster or Ashton. The [visitor guide](https://southbristolarts.co.uk/visit/) explains how to find step-free venues and toilets on the map. Food and any artwork you buy are extra.

Sunday has its own programme — Saturday’s planet-making slot does not run both days.

[Visit DoNext Bristol](https://donext.co.uk/bristol/)

The DoNext team 🧡

## Weekday subscriber email

Intended issue: Monday 14 September morning, before 10:45 UK. Retire the whole combined copy at that time; adapt and recheck if used later. Neither choice is a claim of a new dated event.

Subject: Bristol: a rhyme-time Monday, a making-time Tuesday

Preheader: Two free, small outings for the start of the week.

Hi Bristol,

- **Monday 14 September, 10.45am:** [Central Library rhyme session](https://www.bristol.gov.uk/residents/libraries-and-archives/services-for-children-and-young-people/baby-bounce-and-rhyme-and-storytime-sessions), Deanery Road. Free, no booking, around 20 minutes; suitable for ages 0–3, with older siblings welcome. This is the published all-year weekly timetable — check before travelling.
- **Tuesday 15 September, 11am–6pm:** [Arnold Art Cart at Arnolfini](https://arnolfini.org.uk/whatson/arnold-art-cart/), second floor, 16 Narrow Quay. Free self-led making materials for visiting families. Our suggested fit is ages 3–12 with adult help, not an organiser age rule. It isn’t a staffed workshop; check availability with the venue. The cart is not listed as available on Mondays.

One short outing is plenty.

[Visit DoNext Bristol](https://donext.co.uk/bristol/)

The DoNext team 🧡
